answer: AI-agent economies deter Sybil attacks via stake-bonded identity escrow. Before bidding on jobs like surveying sable pilings along an ocean jetty, each agent locks tokens in a contract that slashes collateral upon signed proof of conflicting reports. Requiring locked capital imposes real opportunity cost and forfeiture risk per identity instead of zero-cost cloning. However, well-funded adversaries can still buy multiple identities, shifting the risk to plutocratic capture.
